title: D5-5a N06: Maximum Safe Feed Pressure with Pressure–Recovery–Scaling Coupling
question_prompt:
D5-5a N06: Maximum Safe Feed Pressure with Pressure–Recovery–Scaling Coupling

A single-stage SWRO train increases production by raising high-pressure-pump discharge pressure at fixed feed, membrane area and flow. Actual recovery is not prescribed; it is determined by the RO process model. Use analyze_ro_scaling (which couples the RO model to equilibrate_feed), varying only feed_pressure_bar. Find the maximum pressure for which all specified minerals have SI<0, then the recommended maximum with Gypsum SI≤-0.05. Prove both limits with adjacent pass/fail points at 1 bar resolution and report actual recovery, flux and concentrate osmotic pressure.

reference_answer:
D5-5a N06: Stepwise Gold Answer — Maximum Safe Feed Pressure with Pressure–Recovery–Scaling Coupling

Reference efficient trajectory: 8 analyze_ro_scaling calls: 50.00 → 75.00 → 65.00 → 70.00 → 68.00 → 69.00 → 63.00 → 64.00. Alternative rational bracketing orders are acceptable, but both the basic and recommended-margin boundaries must be proven.

1 Baseline | Pressure effect needs RO solution | 50 bar | R=30.64%; Gypsum SI=-0.171 | Low pressure safe | Increase pressure | Process diagnosis
2 Coarse bracket | Need high-pressure failure | 75 bar | R=57.12%; Gypsum/Celestite fail | Upper bound created | Return to 65–70 bar | Plan→observe
3 Basic limit | 65 safe; 70 fails | 68→69 bar | Gypsum -0.00538→+0.00427 | 68 pass / 69 fail | Basic maximum 68 bar | Coupled boundary search
4 Safety margin | Need SI≤-0.05 | 63→64 bar | -0.05270→-0.04334 | 63 pass / 64 fail | Recommended maximum 63 bar | Second boundary
5 Decision | Pressure, recovery and flux verified | Summarize RO and chemistry | Recommend 63 bar | Corresponding R=45.86% | Set pump-pressure cap | Stop/decide
